name: Elbe ferry Glückstadt–Wischhafen (FRS Elbfähre), trucks and their load
law: FRS Elbfähre's fares for trucks and cargo, valid 1 January to 31 December 2026 (the Internet Archive's copy of 8 November 2026): a truck, unloaded and without its driver, net of 19% VAT, by its length over all: to 5 m EUR 13.87, to 6 m EUR 16.39, to 7 m EUR 19.75, to 8 m EUR 23.11, to 9 m EUR 24.37, to 10 m EUR 25.63, to 11 m EUR 27.73, to 12 m EUR 28.99, to 13 m EUR 30.25, to 14 m EUR 32.35, to 15 m EUR 34.03, to 16 m EUR 34.87, to 17 m EUR 36.13, to 18.35 m EUR 37.39, each further metre (overhanging ones too) EUR 4.20, at most 23 m; the load by weight, EUR 1.26 per started 1,000 kg. Plus the fuel surcharge per truck of EUR 2.00 (as of 2026-05-06; the page gives one amount, taken as published). The driver's own fare (adults "from" EUR 3.40) isn't added, nor the surcharges for over 2.50 m wide (30%) or dangerous goods, nor the frequent travellers' discounts. Ports at OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals, priced where the line goes out on its car ferry line.
